moments.title: Bank Holiday Weekend Arrives
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, creating a long weekend across much of the UK.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: That glorious August Bank Holiday weekend feeling is just around the corner! What are your plans for the extra day off?

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Planning a Bank Holiday getaway? Remember Monday 31st August is a Bank Holiday in England, Wales & Northern Ireland. Check travel before you go!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Underway
moments.blurb: Reading and Leeds Festivals kick off this Thursday, August 27th, running until Sunday 30th, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds! Who's heading to Bramham Park or Richfield Avenue this weekend? The festivals kick off Thursday with a massive lineup!

angles.name: Headline Picks
angles.copy: Florence + The Machine, Dave, Charli XCX, Raye, Fontaines D.C. – just some of the huge names hitting Reading & Leeds this weekend. Your must-see act?

moments.title: US Open Main Draw Begins
moments.blurb: The US Open Tennis Championships main draw officially gets underway on Sunday, August 30th, at Flushing Meadows, New York.

angles.name: Grand Slam Action
angles.copy: Game, Set, Match! The final Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, starts its main draw on Sunday. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Tennis Excitement
angles.copy: The hard courts of Flushing Meadows are calling! US Open main draw action begins this Sunday. Get ready for two weeks of incredible tennis.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the Official UK Singles Chart No. 1 spot for its 22nd non-consecutive week, a new record.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: 22 weeks at No.1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just keep on reigning in the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. History in the making!

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: Still number one! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean makes it a record-breaking 22 non-consecutive weeks atop the UK Singles Chart. Incredible!

moments.title: Marshall Thompson of The Chi-Lites is 84
moments.blurb: Marshall Thompson, drummer and a founding member of legendary R&B group The Chi-Lites, turns 84 today.

angles.name: Soul Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 84th birthday to Marshall Thompson, the incredible drummer and a founder of The Chi-Lites! What's your favourite Chi-Lites track?

moments.title: Jean-Michel Jarre is 78
moments.blurb: Pioneering French electronic music composer Jean-Michel Jarre celebrates his 78th birthday today.

angles.name: Electronic Icon
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday to the visionary electronic musician Jean-Michel Jarre! His influence on ambient and electronic music is immense.

moments.title: Mark Bedford of Madness is 65
moments.blurb: Mark Bedford, bassist for iconic British band Madness, turns 65 today.

angles.name: Madness Monday
angles.copy: It's a 'One Step Beyond' kind of day! Happy 65th birthday to Mark Bedford, bassist for the legendary Madness!

moments.title: Gene Simmons of KISS is 77
moments.blurb: The Demon himself, Gene Simmons, bassist and co-lead vocalist of KISS, celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Rock God
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we raise a glass to the one and only Gene Simmons of KISS, turning 77! What's your favourite KISS anthem?

moments.title: Elvis Costello is 72
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello will be 72 tomorrow.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd birthday for tomorrow to the brilliant Elvis Costello! From 'Pump It Up' to 'Alison', his catalogue is timeless.

moments.title: Shirley Manson of Garbage is 60
moments.blurb: Scottish singer Shirley Manson, lead vocalist of alternative rock band Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Alt Rock Queen
angles.copy: Happy 60th birthday on Wednesday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage! Still 'Stupid Girl'? Never!

moments.title: Alex Lifeson of Rush is 73
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist Alex Lifeson of Canadian rock band Rush turns 73 on Thursday.

angles.name: Prog Rock Master
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 73rd birthday for Thursday to Alex Lifeson, the phenomenal guitarist from Rush! What's your favourite Rush riff?

moments.title: Shania Twain is 61
moments.blurb: Country-pop superstar Shania Twain celebrates her 61st birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Let's go, girls! Happy 61st birthday on Friday to the iconic Shania Twain! Still 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!'

moments.title: Florence Welch of Florence + The Machine is 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, turns 40 on Friday.

angles.name: Art Rock Star
angles.copy: Happy 40th birthday for Friday to the incredible Florence Welch! The voice of Florence + The Machine continues to enchant.

moments.title: Paul Oakenfold is 63
moments.blurb: Legendary British trance DJ and producer Paul Oakenfold celebrates his 63rd birthday this Sunday.

angles.name: Trance Icon
angles.copy: Get ready to drop the beats! Happy 63rd birthday this Sunday to the iconic DJ Paul Oakenfold. What's your favourite Oakey set?

moments.title: Debbie Gibson is 56
moments.blurb: 80s pop sensation Debbie Gibson will celebrate her 56th birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Out of the blue, it's Debbie Gibson's birthday on Monday! The 80s pop icon turns 56. Time to blast 'Lost In Your Eyes'!

moments.title: Al Jardine of The Beach Boys is 84
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, co-founder and guitarist of The Beach Boys, celebrates his 84th birthday on Thursday, September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boy Legend
angles.copy: Good Vibrations! Happy 84th birthday on Thursday to Al Jardine of The Beach Boys. Still bringing us those summer sounds.
